All 7 derived TPC consumers validate on native-generated base data (tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, datavault, tpcds_obt smoke; ai_primitives datagen).

Required path-filtered CI check native-datagen-parity runs SF 0.01/0.1 TPC-H and SF 1 TPC-DS on PRs touching the adapter, TPC generator, derived-consumer, converter or parity test paths (all inputs to Gates A/B), and the SF 1/10 matrix when the tpcgen-cli pin changes; dependency-only changes without a tpcgen-cli pin change do not trigger it; the job prints wall time and peak RSS per scale (Linux Gate D record).

Gate D: N=3 medians against the budgets in the ADR section "Performance budgets" (TPC-H SF 1 <= 3 s / 1,536 MiB, SF 10 <= 30 s / 2,048 MiB; TPC-DS SF 1 <= 3 s / 1,024 MiB, SF 10 <= 30 s / 2,048 MiB), at SF 1 and SF 10 for both benchmarks measured on final code under make heavy-run with host 5-minute load below 3, recorded with host load in the PR body. Native generation removes leftover .tpcgen-* staging directories from an interrupted run before generating, and fails loudly if tpcgen-cli output contains CRLF row endings instead of silently leaving trailing delimiters.
SF 10 is added to VERIFIED_BYTE_IDENTICAL_BACKENDS only after SF 10 parity passes on the final code.

description:
## Problem
TPC-H and TPC-DS (plus their derived benchmarks) currently rely exclusively on bundled per-OS C dbgen/dsdgen binaries. Upstream datafusion-contrib/tpcgen-rs publishes prebuilt tpcgen-cli wheels on PyPI that can accelerate all 10 TPC-backed benchmarks in parallel without creating a new Rust repository.

## Change
- Add optional extra native-datagen = ["tpcgen-cli==<pin>"] in pyproject.toml with exact version and wheel hashes pinned in uv.lock (via uv lock / uv add --optional).
- Implement a subprocess adapter for tpch and tpcds (--compat c) behind --datagen-backend native, invoking tpcgen-cli across the same execution boundary used by dbgen/dsdgen today.
- Strip exactly one trailing `|` per row in place after tpcgen-cli writes each file (`strip_trailing_delimiters_in_place`), a stated stopgap until datagen-tpcgen-adopt-no-trailing-delimiter; legacy normalization and row-count code stay unchanged; remove leftover `.tpcgen-*` staging dirs; fail loudly on CRLF output. Match chunk file naming (<table>.tbl.<n>.zst etc.) so loaders and all derived benchmarks see an identical layout.
- Support opt-in direct tpcgen-cli Parquet output recorded in data_generation_hash while keeping BenchBox's streaming Parquet converter as default for Parquet runs.
- Preserve _generation_in_progress markers, atomic renames, and Python-only DataGenerationManifest emission; keep C dbgen/dsdgen intact for refresh sets (RF1/RF2, TPC-DS updates) and unsupported platforms (Windows arm64).
- Add required path-filtered CI checks (Gates A, B, D) triggered on PRs touching the adapter, TPC generator, derived-consumer, converter or parity test paths, or changing the tpcgen-cli pin (not on other dependency changes): SF 0.01/0.1 on PRs, SF 1/10 on pin bumps; SHA-256 delimited parity, DuckDB EXCEPT ALL Parquet parity, TPC-DS NULL/empty-string/encoding checks, and derived-benchmark smoke suites (tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, datavault, tpcds_obt).

## Decision gates
- If datagen-p0-tpcgen-parity-spike identified a blocking parity gap on tpcds (or a specific scale), wire only the verified benchmark(s) behind native and leave the unverified benchmark blocked with an explicit error until fixed upstream.
- Stop and report if any derived benchmark smoke suite fails on native-generated base data.

## Guardrails
- Keep legacy as the default backend for tpch and tpcds in this item.
- Never remove any binary from benchbox/_binaries/ (dbgen/dsdgen stay for refresh sets, Windows arm64, and legacy fallback; qgen/dsqgen/templates always stay).
- Never create a perpetual non-blocking nightly job; parity tests run as required path-filtered PR/pin-bump CI checks.
- Core benchbox remains py3-none-any; native-datagen stays optional.
- Follow AGENTS.md ([COMMENT-POLICY-001], [HEAVY-LOCK-001], [RUN-DATA-001], linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR).
